Short title
1. This Act is the FIXTURE Contract Terms Act 2099.
Exclusion of liability
2.—(1) A FIXTURE term excluding liability is effective only if it is reasonable.
(2) Reasonableness is judged at the FIXTURE time of contracting.
[FIXTURE amendment note — not statutory text]
Agreed sums
2A. A FIXTURE agreed sum payable on breach is recoverable if it is a genuine pre-estimate of loss.
Saving
3. Nothing in this FIXTURE Act affects any other rule.
